mapper.sql: FROM wf_instance i JOIN wf_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.tenant_id = i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.starter_id AND u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id

SELECT i.id, i.definition_id, d.name AS definition_name, i.version_no, i.business_key, i.status, i.starter_id, u.display_name AS starter_name, i.created_at, COALESCE((SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.node_id ORDER BY t.id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM wf_task t WHERE t.instance_id = i.id AND t.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND t.status = 'PENDING'), '') AS current_node
mapper.select: AND (i.created_at < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (i.created_at = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND i.id < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT i.id, i.definition_id, d.name AS definition_name, d.code AS definition_code, i.version_no, i.business_key, i.business_type, i.business_title, i.business_round, i.project_ref, i.project_name, i.action_path, i.status, i.starter_id, u.display_name AS starter_name, i.created_at FROM wf_instance i JOIN wf_definition d ON d.id = i.definition_id AND d.tenant_id = i.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.starter_id AND u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.id = #{instanceId} AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.deleted = 0
SELECT CAST(v.definition_json AS CHAR) AS definition_json FROM wf_version v WHERE v.definition_id = #{definitionId} AND v.version_no = #{versionNo} AND v.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT status FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_instance SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT flowable_process_instance_id FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_task SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE wf_instance SET status = 'TERMINATED' WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.node_id, t.task_key, t.task_type, t.assignee_name, t.status, t.comment, t.created_at, t.completed_at FROM wf_task t WHERE t.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id

SELECT a.id, a.event_type, a.operator_id, u.display_name AS operator_name, a.reason, a.payload_json, a.created_at FROM wf_audit_event a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.operator_id AND u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY a.created_at, a.id
